# Gamma distribution {#sec-gamma}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}
$$
f(x; \alpha, \beta) = \frac{\beta^\alpha}{\Gamma(\alpha)} x^{\alpha - 1}
$${#eq-gamma}

α = shape parameter
β = rate parameter (sometimes scale is used instead)
Γ(α) = Gamma function
x>0 is the support of the distribution

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Gamma Distribution - Probability Density Function with different shape and rate parameters"
#| label: fig-gamma-dist

# Set up the plot with appropriate range
plot(NULL, xlim = c(0, 8), ylim = c(0, 0.75),
     xlab = "x", ylab = "f(x)",
     main = "Gamma Distribution - Probability Density Function")

# Define parameters and colors
params <- list(
  list(alpha = 1, beta = 1/2, label = "α=1, β=1/2", color = "blue"),
  list(alpha = 1, beta = 1/4, label = "α=1, β=1/4", color = "red"),
  list(alpha = 6, beta = 2, label = "α=8, β=1", color = "green")
)

# Plot each distribution
for (i in seq_along(params)) {
  alpha <- params[[i]]$alpha
  beta <- params[[i]]$beta
  color <- params[[i]]$color

  # Create sequence of x values
  x <- seq(0, 8, length.out = 500)
  y <- dgamma(x, shape = alpha, rate = beta)

  # Plot the curve
  lines(x, y, col = color, lwd = 2)
}

# Add legend
legend("topright",
       legend = c("α=1, β=1/2", "α=1, β=1/4", "α=8, β=1"),
       col = c("blue", "red", "green"),
       lwd = 2,
       cex = 0.9)

# Add grid for better readability
grid()
```
